title: A test-run wait on a hostless WinB run delivered UNKNOWN (process gone) although the run's own results.json says passed; the host clock was moved back one hour during the run
outcome: A test-run wait delivers the run's real terminal outcome when its results.json is terminal, also when the host's wall clock moves during the run; if it cannot, it says why instead of UNKNOWN (process gone).
acceptance: A test-run wait on a hostless WinB run delivered UNKNOWN (process gone) although the run's own results.json says passed; the host clock was moved back one hour during the run is done
